description: Skill for creating a new mechanism module in kb/modules/ (a conserved pathological process that recurs across disorders). Covers the module schema shape, the trigger→consequence node chain, the treatment target_mechanisms drug pattern, the Xogenesis open-ontology anchor convention, evidence discipline, validation, and registration.
